item.title: Leader of EHDC criticises Local Government Reorganisation
item.description: Cllr Richard Millard shared his disappointment with Shine Radio as the recent decision from the Government to split East Hampshire into two new mainland authorities.

item.title: The PPod – on location at the Clanfield Centre
item.description: This time we are on at the Clanfield Centre. The centre provides sports facilities, classes, a café, regular social meetings and is the home of the Parish council

item.title: Natural pause on the Heath work for bird breeding season
item.description: Some of the conservation work on the Heath is being paused. Jordan Bleach from the Friends of Petersfield Heath tells us about this natural break.

item.title: Clanfield Film Club
item.description: The Clanfield Centre will be hosting a new film club. The first showing will be Jaws on 9th April

item.title: Clive is the Liphook u3a expert on our local Pubs and Churches
item.description: Clive Evenden runs the Liphook u3a group who visit the beautiful churches and pubs in the Petersphere. Mark Simpson asked him about his favourites and what happened when he moved here, after spending 20 years as a youth officer in Essex

item.title: Why not sign up to the Hampshire Alert scheme
item.description: If you want to stay informed about issues in your area that are relevant to you, then go to Hampshirealert.co.uk It is a free messaging service that allows Hampshire and IOW Constabulary, Neighbourhood Watch and other organisations to send you messages, witness appeals and general policing activity in your area.

item.title: Petersfield Guides appeal for new members
item.description: Petersfield Guides are looking for new members - it's modern, fun and helps girls learn about themselves says local leader Megan Evans.

item.title: Broken items brought back into use at the new Repair Café
item.description: Last Saturday brought many residents of Petersfield through the door at the Avenue Pavilion. They brought items that may have found their way to landfill, but instead were given a new lease of life.

item.title: The Easter message is one of hope
item.description: The Rev Will Hughes from St Peter's explains the significance of Easter and all the events - and colours - around it. And it includes chocolate!

item.title: River, the signal crayfish detection dog
item.description: River, a little black spaniel in a bright orange vest is searching the river bank in the nature reserve behind Petersfield Rugby Club. But what is she looking for?
